title: 第三章 心动
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈舟走到电动车旁，张晚柠拿了另一个头盔，套在他头上，戴好之后还贴心地给陈舟系好带子。

“完美，perfect！”张晚柠站在车旁，上下打量了一下陈舟，满意地点了点头，上了车，侧过脑袋拍了拍车后座，“来吧，上车吧。”

陈舟像胆小菇一样，脑袋缩了缩，坐在后座上。

刚一坐上后座，一股少女特有的香气扑面而来，不像是香水味，反而是带着一股薰衣草的清香，陈舟猛地嗅了嗅，暗自感叹，好好闻。

“坐好了吗？”

前面的张晚柠侧着精致的脸，关心的问道。

“好了！”

听着少女清脆的声音，陈舟心底的甜蜜如同电流般蔓延到指尖，抓了抓电动车前座，碰到柠柠裙摆的时候，手指不小心往回缩了缩。

张晚柠在陈舟面前算是卸下了伪装，转身眉眼轻笑，声音有些调皮，左手伸出白皙修长的手指，指了指前面。

“gogogo，出发咯。”

新生开学的时候，校园里人流涌动，张晚柠车子开得很稳，不一会儿就挤出学校，开到了马路上。

驶出学校一段路程后，街道变得开阔，车子行驶速度也快了起来，夏日的微风拂在陈舟脸上，抚平了一些南方空气中郁积的闷热。

距离学校最近商场内挤满了人，大多是两个家长带着一个孩子，显然是新生开学，家长来商场带孩子吃饭，这让陈舟和张晚柠这对俊男靓女显得有些别具一格。

陈舟和张晚柠肩并肩地走着，俩人中间的间隔大约几厘米，两人的手时不时地碰在一起，然后不约而同地缩回去。

没一会儿，俩人到了他们刚刚看得那家烤肉店，张晚柠走到了一个角落的座位，先坐了下来。

张晚柠看着眼前这个有些笨拙的男孩，心里满是疑问，他怎么知道自己在南城师大？

等陈舟坐好之后，张晚柠轻声问道。

“舟舟，你怎么知道我在南城师大的？”

怎么知道的吗？

Page (1/3)

Chen Zhou walked to the electric car. Zhang Wanning took another helmet and put it on his head. After putting it on, he tied the straps for Chen Zhou thoughtfully.

"Perfect, perfect!" Zhang Wanning stood beside the car, looked Chen Zhou up and down, nodded with satisfaction, got in the car, turned his head and patted the back seat of the car, "Come on, get in the car."

Like a timid mushroom, Chen Zhou shrank his head and sat in the back seat.

As soon as he sat in the back seat, a girl's unique fragrance hit his face. It didn't smell like perfume, but instead had the fragrance of lavender. Chen Zhou took a sharp sniff and sighed to himself, it smelled good.

"Are you seated?"

Zhang Wanning in front asked with concern, her delicate face tilted sideways.

"Okay!"

Listening to the girl's crisp voice, the sweetness in Chen Zhou's heart spread to his fingertips like electricity. He grabbed the front seat of the electric car and accidentally retracted his fingers when they touched the hem of Ning Ning's skirt.

Zhang Wanning finally took off her disguise in front of Chen Zhou. She turned around and smiled with a naughty voice. She stretched out her slender white fingers on her left hand and pointed in front of him.

"gogogo, let's go."

When the freshmen started school, the campus was crowded with people. Zhang Wanning drove the car very steadily, and soon squeezed out of the school and drove onto the road.

After driving out of the school for a while, the streets became wider and the car drove faster. The summer breeze blew on Chen Zhou's face, smoothing away some of the sultry heat in the southern air.

The shopping mall closest to the school was crowded with people, mostly two parents with one child. It was obviously the beginning of the new semester, and the parents came to the shopping mall to take their children to eat. This made the handsome couple Chen Zhou and Zhang Wanning look a bit unique.

Chen Zhou and Zhang Wanning walked side by side, with about a few centimeters between them. Their hands touched each other from time to time, and then retracted in unison.

After a while, the two of them arrived at the barbecue restaurant they had just seen. Zhang Wanning walked to a corner seat and sat down first.

Zhang Wanning looked at the clumsy boy in front of him and was full of questions. How did he know that he was at Nancheng Normal University?

After Chen Zhou sat down, Zhang Wanning asked softly.

"Zhouzhou, how did you know that I was at Nancheng Normal University?"

How do you know?
